name: RoadmapItem
description: A single item on a public product road map, representing a feature, initiative, or release the product team plans to ship.

id.description: Stable identifier for the road map item within the source platform.

title.description: Short, customer-facing title for the road map item.

description.description: Longer customer-facing description of the road map item.
description.example: Allow customers to sign in to the product using Okta-managed identities, including SCIM-based provisioning.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the road map item.

timeframe.description: Road map bucket the item lives in.

tags.description: Tags used to categorize the road map item.

product_area.description: Product area or component this item belongs to.

owner.description: Person or team accountable for delivering the item.

target_release.description: Planned release or milestone the item is associated with.

target_date.description: Optional planned ship date for the item.

visibility.description: Whether the item is visible on the public road map or only internally.

url.description: URL where the road map item can be viewed publicly.

vote_count.description: Aggregate number of customer votes attached to the item.

updated_at.description: When the item was last updated.

source_platform.description: Name of the platform of record for this road map item.
